title: If the fergi fits, wear it
creator_credit: John Cosgrove, Dan Gomez and Walt Disney Educational Media Company
brief_description: Presents the story of the first business venture by a teenage brother and sister who decide to sell silk-screened T-shirts. Shows some of the responsibilities and advantages of going into business. Suitable for secondary level.
